title: City Mulls Time-Warner Lawsuit, Land Deal
summary:
*   **Potential Lawsuit Against Time-Warner:** Discussed possible litigation targeting the Time-Warner Entertainment Center.
*   **Future of City Property:** Reviewed the proposed transfer of city-owned land located at E. 14th and Waller Streets.
*   **Public Health Focus:** Received a briefing regarding a Federally Qualified Health Center, highlighting an ongoing commitment to community health services.
